_schema.description: Curated common Smogon-style sets per Pokemon. Used by NonRandomResolver as opponent priors in non-random formats (OU, customgame, etc.). Phase 1 picks default_spread_idx; Phase 2 will narrow across all entries via damage observation. Generated from smogon/damage-calc gen9.js (SETDEX_SV).

spread_fields.name: human label for the spread
spread_fields.nature: lowercase nature id (e.g. jolly, adamant, modest)
spread_fields.level: int, normally 100 for OU and 50 for VGC
spread_fields.item: lowercase item id with no spaces/hyphens, or null
spread_fields.tera_type: lowercase type id (e.g. fire, water, ghost), or null when no tera declared
spread_fields.moves: list of lowercase move ids with no spaces/hyphens

_schema.default_spread_idx: 0-indexed pointer into spreads[] used by Phase 1
